description: Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha - List of Predeshiya Sabha Roads
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with the declaration of roads and lanes as property owned by the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of land parcels (roads and lanes) with coordinates, measurements, and legal notifications about land ownership claims. This falls under land and property-related matters, specifically land registrations and ownership declarations, which is the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
